message:
🚀 Flex GUI Pro — Version 8.0.0 Release
Our biggest release yet—"Build It, Don't Fake It"—brings WEB→AE, Animated Gradients, official Map Rigs, 3D Carousels, in-panel Text Properties, and major performance updates.

♦️ WEB→AE — Live Webpages to AE Compositions
* DOM to Native Layers: Send live webpages into AE as editable text, bezier vector shapes (with per-corner radius), and converted SVGs.
* Browser Extension: 1-click capture via floating pill, popup, or Alt+Shift+A (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc) with live font substitution and Retina preview.

♦️ Animated Gradients (Colors Tab ▸ ANIM)
* Animated SaaS Palettes: Animate any curated or custom palette using real, timeline-editable keyframes—no expressions.
* Seamless Loops & Smart Span: The last keyframe lands precisely on the first for a jump-free loop. Automatically matches selected layer duration or generates a full-comp background.

♦️ Map Rigs (Out of Beta)
* Official Country Borders: Official boundary data for 31 countries (India w/ complete J&K, Pakistan, China, Morocco, etc.) plus Neutral POV.
* Locked Trace Outlines: Traces and tracker points auto-attach and stay locked through pans, zooms, and fly-throughs.
* Rebuilt 5-Step UI: Streamlined steps (Place, Look, Layers, Move, Maps) with permanent layer IDs.

♦️ 3D Carousel Engine (Orb Generator)
* 6 Instant Looks: Horizontal Curve, Cylindrical/Tilted Rings, Vertical Stack, Floating Perspective, and Sphere Cloud.
* Live Viewport & Auto-Loop: Viewport matches your AE comp camera, auto-loads comp layers into draggable slots, and loops infinitely.

♦️ Text Properties Panel
* In-Panel Character Controls: Edit fonts, sizes, tracking, leading, kerning, and baseline shift without opening AE's Character panel.
* Searchable Fonts & Batch Edits: Type to search installed fonts; restyle multiple selected text layers simultaneously.

♦️ Corner Rounder & AutoCaptions
* Live Corner Rounder: Round or chamfer any shape or mask path with vertex tracking and auto edge-length clamping.
* AutoCaption Typography: 5 interlocking lockups, 6 bundled open-licensed fonts, and 1-click Looks.

♦️ Performance & Stability
* Zero Idle CPU Drain: Removed background polling timers and high-frequency filesystem checks.
* Typing Focus Fix: Fixed panel focus stealing keystrokes while editing AE text layers.
